sentences.zh: 或有既周而禫服終三年者；

translations.literal: some, having completed one cycle, wore end-of-mourning garments for the full three years;
translations.idiomatic: some kept end-of-mourning dress the full three years after one cycle;

sentences.zh: 或有依上元之制，齊衰三年者。

translations.literal: some followed the Shangyuan system of hemmed sackcloth three years.
translations.idiomatic: some followed Shangyuan's hemmed sackcloth for three years.

sentences.zh: 時議者是非紛然，元行沖謂人曰：「聖人制厭降之禮，豈不知母恩之深也，以尊祖貴祢，欲其遠別禽獸，近異夷狄故也。

translations.literal: Debaters of the time right and wrong were clamorous; Yuan Xingchong said to people: "The sage instituted the ritual of honored reduction—how could he not know the depth of a mother's kindness? It is because one honors the grandfather and values the temple founder, wishing people to keep far from beasts and near yet distinct from barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Debaters of the time right and wrong were clamorous; Yuan Xingchong said to people: "The sage instituted the ritual of honored reduction—how could he not know the depth of a mother's kindness? It is because one honors the grandfather and values the temple founder, wishing people to keep far from beasts and near yet distinct from barbarians.

sentences.zh: 人情易搖，淺識者眾。

translations.literal: Human feeling is easy to sway; those of shallow understanding are many.
translations.idiomatic: Feeling sways easily; shallow views are common.

sentences.zh: 一紊其度，其可止乎！」

translations.literal: Once the measure is disorderly, how can it be stopped!"
translations.idiomatic: Once the measure is disorderly, how can it be stopped!"

sentences.zh: 二十年，中書令蕭嵩與學士改修定五禮，又議請依上元敕，父在為母齊衰三年為定。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Secretariat Director Xiao Song and academicians again revised and fixed the Five Rites, and again deliberated requesting that according to the Shangyuan decree, when the father is alive hemmed sackcloth three years for the mother be made fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Year twenty: Secretariat Director Xiao Song and the academicians revised the Five Rites and again asked to fix Shangyuan's rule—hemmed sackcloth three years for a mother while the father lived.

sentences.zh: 及頒禮，乃一依行焉。

translations.literal: When the rites were promulgated, all followed it in practice.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were issued, everyone followed them.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，藉田禮畢，正制曰：「服制之紀，或有所未通，宜令禮官學士詳議聞奏。」太常卿韋縚奏曰：「謹按《儀禮喪服》：舅，緦麻三月。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, after the plowing rite was completed, a formal ordinance said: "In the regulations of mourning dress, some points may not yet be fully understood. Let ritual officials and scholars deliberate in detail and report." Wei Tao, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, memorialized: "Respectfully according to the Ceremonies and Rites, Mourning Dress: for a maternal uncle, fine hemp for three months.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, after the plowing rite was completed, a formal ordinance said: "In the regulations of mourning dress, some points may not yet be fully understood. Let ritual officials and scholars deliberate in detail and report." Wei Tao, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, memorialized: "Respectfully according to the Ceremonies and Rites, Mourning Dress: for a maternal uncle, fine hemp for three months.

sentences.zh: 從母，小功五月。

translations.literal: Mother's sister, five months' lesser accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: A mother's sister, five months' lesser accomplishment.

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：可以小功，以名加也。

translations.literal: The Commentary says: one may use lesser accomplishment—added by the name.
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary: lesser accomplishment may apply—the name adds the grade.

sentences.zh: 堂姨舅、舅母，恩所不及。

translations.literal: Hall mother's brothers and sisters, mother's brothers' wives—kindness does not reach.
translations.idiomatic: Hall cousins on the mother's side and uncles' wives—kindness does not reach them.

sentences.zh: 外祖父母。

translations.literal: Maternal grandparents.
translations.idiomatic: Maternal grandparents—

sentences.zh: 小功五月。

translations.literal: five months' lesser accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: five months of lesser accomplishment mourning.

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：何以小功，以尊加也。

translations.literal: The Commentary says: why lesser accomplishment? Added by the honored status.
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary asks why lesser accomplishment: honor raises the grade.

sentences.zh: 舅，緦麻三月，並是情親而服屬疏者也。

translations.literal: Mother's brother, three months' finest hemp—all are close in feeling yet distant in garment kinship.
translations.idiomatic: A mother's brother, three months' finest hemp—all close in feeling, distant in kin grade.

sentences.zh: 外祖正尊，同於從母之服。

translations.literal: Maternal grandparents are primary elders, the same as mourning for the mother's sister.
translations.idiomatic: Maternal grandparents are primary elders, the same grade as a mother's sister.

sentences.zh: 姨舅一等，服則輕重有殊。

translations.literal: Mother's sister and mother's brother are one class, yet garments differ in light and heavy.
translations.idiomatic: Mother's sister and mother's brother are one class, yet the garments differ in weight.

sentences.zh: 堂姨舅親即未疏，恩絕不相為服。

translations.literal: Hall mother's brothers and sisters—the kin is not yet distant, yet kindness is severed and they do not wear mourning for one another.
translations.idiomatic: Hall cousins are not yet distant kin, yet kindness is cut and they wear no mourning for each other.

sentences.zh: 親舅母來承外族，同爨之禮不加。

translations.literal: A mother's brother's wife who comes to join the outer clan—the ritual of sharing the hearth is not added.
translations.idiomatic: An uncle's wife who joins the outer clan does not receive the shared-hearth rite.

sentences.zh: 竊以古意猶有所未暢者也。

translations.literal: I venture that in ancient intent something is still not fully expressed.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient intent, he ventured, was not yet fully expressed.

sentences.zh: 且為外祖小功，此則正尊情甚親而服屬疏者也，請加至大功九月。

translations.literal: Moreover for maternal grandparents lesser accomplishment—this is primary elder, feeling very close yet garment kinship distant—we request increase to greater accomplishment nine months.
translations.idiomatic: Maternal grandparents wore lesser accomplishment though feeling was very close and kin grade distant—he asked to raise them to nine months' greater accomplishment.

sentences.zh: 姨舅儕類，親既無別，服宜齊等，請為舅加至小功五月。

translations.literal: Mother's sister and mother's brother are the same class; the kin is without distinction—the garment ought to be equal; we request for the mother's brother increase to five months' lesser accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: Mother's sister and mother's brother were the same class without kin distinction—the garment should match; he asked five months' lesser accomplishment for a mother's brother.

sentences.zh: 堂姨舅疏降一等，親舅母從服之例，先無制服之文，並望加至袒免。

translations.literal: Hall mother's brothers and sisters reduced one grade; a mother's brother's wife following-garment precedent—formerly no garment text existed—we together hope to add to baring shoulder and untying cap-band.
translations.idiomatic: Hall cousins dropped one grade; an uncle's wife had no prior garment rule—he asked baring shoulder and untying the cap-band for them all.

sentences.zh: 臣聞禮以飾情，服從義制，或有沿革，損益可明。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that rites adorn feeling and mourning garments follow righteous regulation; there may be continuations and changes, and what is to be reduced or increased can be made clear.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that ritual adorns emotion and mourning dress follows moral rule—where practice has shifted, what to add or trim can be stated plainly.

sentences.zh: 事體既大，理資詳審。

translations.literal: The matter in its substance is already great; reason requires thorough deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The matter is weighty and calls for careful deliberation.

sentences.zh: 望付尚書省集眾官吏詳議，務從折衷，永為典則。」

translations.literal: We hope it may be entrusted to the Department of State Affairs to assemble the multitude of officials for detailed discussion, striving for compromise, and made a perpetual standard."
translations.idiomatic: We hope it may be entrusted to the Department of State Affairs to assemble the multitude of officials for detailed discussion, striving for compromise, and made a perpetual standard."

sentences.zh: 於是太子賓客崔沔建議曰：「竊聞大道既隱，天下為家。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Mentor of the Heir Apparent Cui Mian submitted a recommendation, saying: "Your servant has heard that when the Great Way was concealed, all under Heaven became one's household.
translations.idiomatic: Then Mentor of the Heir Apparent Cui Mian memorialized: "I have heard that once the Great Way was hidden, the realm became a single household.

sentences.zh: 聖人因之，然後製禮。

translations.literal: The sages followed this and thereafter fashioned rites.
translations.idiomatic: The sages took that as their basis and then fashioned ritual.

sentences.zh: 禮教之設，本為正家，家道正而天下定矣。

translations.literal: The establishment of ritual teaching was fundamentally to rectify the family; when the family way is rectified, all under Heaven is settled.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual teaching was instituted chiefly to set the household in order; when the household is right, the realm is stable.

sentences.zh: 正家之道，不可以貳，總一定議，理歸本宗。

translations.literal: The way to rectify the family cannot be twofold; to gather and fix one deliberation, reason returns to the root lineage.
translations.idiomatic: The way to order a household cannot be divided in two: one settled rule, with principle anchored in the main line.

sentences.zh: 父以尊崇，母以厭降，豈忘愛敬，宜存倫序。

translations.literal: The father is honored and elevated; the mother is suppressed and demoted—how could one forget love and respect? One should preserve the order of human relations.
translations.idiomatic: The father is exalted and the mother reduced in rank—not to forget love and respect, but to keep relational order.

sentences.zh: 是以內有齊斬，外服皆緦麻，尊名所加，不過一等，此先王不易之道也。

translations.literal: Therefore within there is zhan and cui; for external relations all wear si hemp; where honored names are added, it does not exceed one grade—this is the unchanging way of the former kings.
translations.idiomatic: Hence within the family are the heaviest grades of mourning; for outside kin all wear the lightest hemp; added honor never exceeds one step—this is the former kings' unchanging rule.

sentences.zh: 前聖所志，後賢所傳，其來久矣。

translations.literal: What former sages recorded, later worthies transmitted—their coming has long been so.
translations.idiomatic: What the ancient sages set down and later worthies handed on has stood for ages.

sentences.zh: 昔辛有適伊川，見被髮而祭於野者，曰：『不及百年，此其戎乎？

translations.literal: Long ago Xin You went to Yichuan and saw people with loose hair sacrificing in the open country, and said, 'In less than a hundred years, will this be the Rong?'
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Xin You went to Yichuan and saw people with loose hair sacrificing in the open country, and said, 'In less than a hundred years, will this be the Rong?'

sentences.zh: 其禮先亡矣！』

translations.literal: Their rites will perish first!
translations.idiomatic: Their ritual will die first!

sentences.zh: 貞觀修禮，時改舊章，漸廣渭陽之恩，不遵洙、泗之典。

translations.literal: In Zhenguan's revision of rites the times altered the old statutes, gradually widening the affection of the Wei-yang ode and not following the canons of Zhu and Si.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhenguan revised ritual, old statutes were altered, maternal kin were favored ever more widely, and the standards of Confucius's homeland were left aside.

sentences.zh: 及弘道之後，唐隆之間，國命再移於外族矣。

translations.literal: Reaching after Hongdao and in the Tanglong era, the nation's mandate twice shifted to alien clans.
translations.idiomatic: After Hongdao and in the Tanglong years, the dynastic mandate twice passed to outsiders.

sentences.zh: 禮亡徵兆，儻或斯見，天人之際，可不誡哉！

translations.literal: The perishing of rites had its omens—perhaps this is seen; at the juncture of Heaven and man, can one not be warned!
translations.idiomatic: The death of ritual had its omens—perhaps we see them here; at the meeting of Heaven and humanity, ought we not take warning!

sentences.zh: 開元初，補闕盧履冰嘗進狀論喪服輕重，敕令僉議。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyuan, Remonstrance Councillor Lu Lübing once submitted a memorial discussing the light and heavy grades of mourning garments; an edict ordered collective deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Kaiyuan, Remonstrance Councillor Lu Lübing had memorialized on the grades of mourning dress, and an edict ordered joint deliberation.

sentences.zh: 於時群議紛拏，各安積習，太常禮部，奏依舊定。

translations.literal: At that time the multitude of discussions were tangled; each clung to accumulated custom; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Ministry of Rites memorialized to follow the old fixings.
translations.idiomatic: Debate then was tangled, each side clinging to habit; the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and the Ministry of Rites urged keeping the old rules.

sentences.zh: 陛下運稽古之思，發獨斷之明，至，特降別敕，一依古禮。

translations.literal: Your Majesty, exercising reflection on antiquity and issuing independent, clarifying judgments, by the eighth year of Kaiyuan specially promulgated a separate edict, wholly following the ancient rites.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty, drawing on antiquity and acting with decisive clarity, in Kaiyuan 8 issued a special edict restoring the ancient mourning rules in full.

sentences.zh: 事符故實，人知向方，式固宗盟，社稷之福。

translations.literal: The matter accords with former facts; people know the direction; it firmly secures the clan bond—the fortune of the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: That matched ancient precedent, gave the people a clear standard, and strengthened the clan bond—a blessing to the state.

sentences.zh: 更圖異議，竊所未詳。

translations.literal: To plot further divergent discussion—your servant has not yet understood.
translations.idiomatic: To reopen dispute on this point is, in my view, hard to understand.

sentences.zh: 願守八年明旨，以為萬代成法。」

translations.literal: We hope to preserve the clear directive of the eighth year as the enduring law for ten thousand generations."
translations.idiomatic: We hope to preserve the clear directive of the eighth year as the enduring law for ten thousand generations."

sentences.zh: 職方郎中韋述議曰：天生萬物，惟人最靈。所以尊尊親親，別生分類，存則盡其愛敬，沒則盡其哀戚。緣情而制服，考事而立言，往聖討論，亦已勤矣。上自高祖，下至玄孫，以及其身，謂之九族。由近而及遠，稱情而立文，差其輕重，遂為五服。雖則或以義降，或以名加，教有所從，理不逾等。百王不易，三代可知，日月同懸，咸所仰也。自微言既絕，大義復乖，雖文質有遷，而必遵此制。謹按《儀禮·喪服傳》曰：「外親之服皆緦麻。」鄭玄謂：「外親，異姓。正服不過緦麻。」外祖父母，小功五月，以尊加也。從母，小功五月，以名加也。舅甥外孫、中外昆弟，依本服緦麻三月。若以匹敵，外祖則祖也，舅則伯叔父之別也。姨舅伯叔，則父母之恩不殊，而獨殺於外氏，聖人之心，良有以也。《喪服傳》曰：「禽獸知母而不知父。」野人曰，父母何算焉。都邑之士，則知尊祢矣。大夫及學士，則知尊祖也。諸侯及其太祖，天子及其始祖。聖人究天道而厚於祖祢，系姓族而親其子孫，近則別其賢愚，遠則異於禽獸。由此言之，母黨比於本族，不可同貫明矣。且家無二尊，喪無二斬，人之所奉，不可貳也。特重於大宗者，降其小宗；為人後者，減其父母之服；女子出嫁，殺其本家之喪。蓋所存者遠，所抑者私也。今若外祖及舅更加服一等，堂舅及姨列於服紀之內，則中外之制，相去幾何？廢禮徇情，所務者末。古之製作者知人情之易搖，恐失禮之將漸，別其同異，輕重相懸，欲使後來之人，永不相雜。微旨斯在，豈徒然哉！且五服有上殺之義，必循源本，方及條流。伯叔父母本服大功九月，從父昆弟亦大功九月，並以上出於祖，其服不得過於祖也。從祖祖父母、從祖父母、從祖昆弟，皆小功五月；以出於曾祖，服不得過於曾祖也。族祖祖父母、族祖父母、族祖昆弟，皆緦麻三月，以其出於高祖，其服不得過於高祖也。堂舅姨既出於外曾祖，若為之制服，則外曾祖父母及外伯叔祖父母，亦宜制服矣。外祖加至大功九月，則外曾祖合至小功，外高祖合至緦麻。若舉此而舍彼，事則不均；棄親而錄疏，理則不順。推而廣之，是與本族無異矣。服皆有報，則堂外甥、外曾孫、侄女之子，皆須制服矣。聖人豈薄其骨肉，背其恩愛。情之親者，服制乃輕，蓋本於公者薄於私，存其大者略其細，義有所斷，不得不然。苟可加也，亦可減也，往聖可得而非，則禮經可得而隳矣。先王之制，謂之彝倫，奉以周旋，猶恐失墜，一紊其敘，庸可止乎？且舊章淪胥，為日已久矣。所存者無幾，又欲棄之，雖曰未達，不知其可。請依《儀禮·喪服》為定。

translations.literal: Wei Shu, Bureau Director of Staff Registration, deliberated: Heaven gives birth to the myriad things, and only humans are most numinous. Therefore they honor the honored and love the kin, distinguish those born from one another and classify kinds; while alive they exhaust love and reverence, and when dead they exhaust grief and sorrow. Following feeling they made mourning dress, and examining affairs they established words; former sages discussed this with great diligence. From Gaozu down to great-great-grandsons and including oneself is called the nine kin. From near reaching distant, matching feeling and establishing text, differentiating light and heavy, they then made the five mourning grades. Though some are reduced by obligation and some increased by name, teaching has what it follows and principle does not exceed rank. This was not changed by the hundred kings, and can be known from the Three Dynasties; like sun and moon hanging together, all looked up to it. Since subtle words were cut off and great meaning again went awry, although plainness and refinement changed, this system was necessarily followed. Respectfully according to the Ceremonies and Rites, Mourning Dress Tradition: "Mourning for external kin is all fine hemp." Zheng Xuan says: "External kin are those of different surnames. The regular dress does not exceed fine hemp." Maternal grandparents have small-work mourning for five months because honor adds to it. A mother's sister has small-work mourning for five months because the name adds to it. Maternal uncles, nephews, daughters' children, and cousins across inner and outer lines follow the basic mourning of fine hemp for three months. If matched as equals, a maternal grandfather is a grandfather, and a maternal uncle is the counterpart of a father's elder or younger brother. Aunts and uncles, elder and younger, do not differ in the affection of father and mother, yet only the maternal line is reduced; the sage's intention truly had reason. The Mourning Dress Tradition says: "Birds and beasts know their mothers but do not know their fathers." The rustic says, what reckoning is there of father and mother? Men of towns know to honor the father; great officers and scholars know to honor the ancestor; feudal lords reach their Grand Ancestor, and the Son of Heaven reaches his first ancestor. Sages fully understood the Way of Heaven and gave weight to ancestors and fathers, tied surnames and clans, and loved their descendants; near at hand they distinguished worthy and foolish, and far away they differed from birds and beasts. Speaking from this, it is clear that the mother's party cannot be put on one string with the root clan. Moreover a household has no two honored ones, mourning has no two unhemmed garments, and what a person serves cannot be double. One who gives special weight to the great lineage lowers the small lineage; one adopted as another's heir reduces mourning for his parents; a woman who marries out reduces mourning for her natal family. This is because what is preserved is distant and what is restrained is private. Now if the maternal grandfather and maternal uncle are additionally raised one mourning grade, and second maternal uncles and maternal aunts are arrayed within the mourning regulations, then how far apart are the inner and outer systems? To abandon ritual and follow feeling is to work on the lesser point. Ancient makers of institutions knew that human feeling is easily shaken and feared that loss of ritual would gradually spread. They distinguished sameness and difference and made light and heavy far apart, wanting later people never to mix them. This subtle meaning lies here; how could it be accidental? Moreover the five mourning grades have the meaning of upward reduction. One must follow source and root before reaching branches and streams. Father's brothers and their wives have the basic mourning of great-work mourning for nine months; father's brother's sons also have great-work mourning for nine months, both because above they come from the grandfather, and their mourning cannot exceed that for the grandfather. Grandparents of the grandfather's line, grandparents of the father's cousin line, and cousins of the grandfather's line all have small-work mourning for five months, because they come from the great-grandfather, and the mourning cannot exceed that for the great-grandfather. Clan great-great-grandparents, clan great-grandparents, and clan cousins all have fine hemp for three months, because they come from the high ancestor, and their mourning cannot exceed that for the high ancestor. Second maternal uncles and aunts come from the external great-grandfather; if mourning dress is made for them, then mourning dress should also be made for external great-grandparents and external great-uncles and great-aunts. If the maternal grandfather is increased to great-work mourning for nine months, then the external great-grandfather should reach small-work mourning and the external high ancestor should reach fine hemp. If one raises this but leaves out that, the matter is uneven; to abandon the close and record the distant is contrary to principle. Pushed and broadened, this is no different from the root clan. Mourning all has reciprocal return, so second nephews across the maternal line, external great-grandsons, and the sons of nieces would all require mourning dress. Could sages have been thin toward their own flesh and blood and turned against affection? For those closest in feeling, the mourning system is light because what is based in the public is thinner than the private; it preserves the greater and omits the finer. Obligation has what it cuts off, and it cannot be otherwise. If it can be increased, it can also be reduced. If former sages may be declared wrong, then the ritual classics may be destroyed. The former kings' system is called the constant human order; even when reverently carried out, one fears losing it. Once its sequence is disturbed, how can it be stopped? Moreover the old statutes have sunk and decayed for a long time. What remains is not much, and now one wishes to abandon it. Though this is called lack of understanding, I do not know that it is acceptable. I request that the Ceremonies and Rites, Mourning Dress be followed as the fixed rule.

sentences.zh: 禮部員外郎楊仲昌議曰：「謹按《儀禮》曰：『外服皆緦。』

translations.literal: Yang Zhongchang, Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites, deliberated: "Respectfully according to the Ceremonies and Rites: "All mourning for external kin is fine hemp."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhongchang, Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites, deliberated: "Respectfully according to the Ceremonies and Rites: "All mourning for external kin is fine hemp."

sentences.zh: 又曰：『外祖父母以尊加，從母以名加，並為小功五月。』

translations.literal: It also says: "Maternal grandparents, with honor added, and mothers' sisters, with the name added, both have small-work mourning for five months."
translations.idiomatic: It also says: "Maternal grandparents, with honor added, and mothers' sisters, with the name added, both have small-work mourning for five months."

sentences.zh: 其為舅緦，鄭文貞公魏徵已議同從母例，加至小功五月訖。

translations.literal: For the mother's brother, si hemp—Duke of Zheng Wen, Wei Zheng, already deliberated to follow the mother's-sister precedent, increasing to xiao gong for five months, and that is settled.
translations.idiomatic: For the maternal uncle, si hemp—Wei Zheng, Duke of Zhengwen, had already argued he should match the mother's sister at xiao gong for five months, and that was settled.

sentences.zh: 今之所加，豈異前旨？

translations.literal: What is now to be added—how does it differ from the former intent?
translations.idiomatic: What is now proposed to be added—how does it differ from that earlier ruling?

sentences.zh: 雖文貞賢也，而周、孔聖也，以賢改聖，後學何從？

translations.literal: Though Wen was worthy, yet Zhou and Confucius were sages; to use the worthy to alter the sage—what are later students to follow?
translations.idiomatic: Wei Zheng was worthy, but Zhou and Confucius were sages; to let worthies revise sages—what should later students follow?

sentences.zh: 堂舅姨、堂舅母，並升為袒免，則何以祖述禮經乎？

translations.literal: Hall mother's brothers and sisters and hall mother's brothers' wives, all raised to tan mian—then how may one trace and transmit the ritual classics?
translations.idiomatic: Cousins on the mother's side and their wives, all raised to tan mian—how then can we claim to follow the ritual canon?

sentences.zh: 如以外祖父母加至大功，則豈無加報於外孫乎？

translations.literal: If for maternal grandparents one increases to da gong, then would there not also be added return mourning for maternal grandsons?
translations.idiomatic: If maternal grandparents are raised to da gong, must not maternal grandsons also return the heavier mourning?

sentences.zh: 如外孫為報，服大功，則本宗庶孫，何同等而相淺乎？

translations.literal: If maternal grandsons in return wore da gong, then the common grandsons of the root lineage—why are they equal in rank yet shallower in mourning?
translations.idiomatic: If maternal grandsons wore da gong in return, how could patrilineal grandsons of the same degree wear less?

sentences.zh: 儻必如是，深所不便。

translations.literal: If it must be so, this is deeply inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: If it must be so, the inconvenience is grave.

sentences.zh: 竊恐內外乖序，親疏奪倫、情之所沿，何所不至，理必然也。

translations.literal: Your servant fears inner and outer will lose their order, near and distant will usurp rank, and where feeling leads—what will not follow? Reason demands it.
translations.idiomatic: I fear inner and outer kin will fall out of order and near and far will invert rank—where feeling leads, what limit will hold? That is inevitable.

sentences.zh: 昔子路有姊之喪而不除，孔子問之，子路對曰：『吾寡兄弟而不忍也。』

translations.literal: In antiquity Zilu had mourning for a sister yet did not remove the garments; Confucius questioned him, and Zilu replied: 'I have few brothers and sisters and cannot bear it.'
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Zilu mourned a sister but would not leave off the garments; Confucius asked him, and Zilu said, 'I have few siblings and cannot bear to do so.'

sentences.zh: 子曰：『先王制禮，行道之人皆不忍也。』

translations.literal: The Master said, 'When the former kings made ritual, even passers-by felt the same reluctance.'
translations.idiomatic: The Master said, 'When the former kings made ritual, even passers-by felt the same reluctance.'

sentences.zh: 子路聞而除之。

translations.literal: Zilu heard this and removed the garments.
translations.idiomatic: Zilu heard and removed the mourning.

sentences.zh: 此則聖人因言以立訓，援事抑情之明例也。

translations.literal: This is the sage using words to establish instruction—an illuminating example of citing a case to restrain feeling.
translations.idiomatic: Here the sage turned a remark into teaching—an explicit case of using precedent to curb excess of feeling.

sentences.zh: 禮不云乎，無輕議禮。

translations.literal: Does ritual not say: do not lightly discuss ritual?
translations.idiomatic: Does ritual not say, Do not lightly debate ritual?

sentences.zh: 明共蟠於天地，並彼日月，賢者由之，安敢小有損益也！

translations.literal: Brightness coiled with Heaven and Earth, equal to sun and moon—the worthy follow it; how dare one make small additions or subtractions!
translations.idiomatic: It coils with Heaven and Earth and stands with sun and moon—the worthy follow it; who would dare trim it even slightly!

sentences.zh: 況夫《喪服》之紀，先王大猷，奉以周旋，以匡人道。

translations.literal: How much more the records of Mourning Garments—the great design of the former kings, upheld in practice to rectify the human way.
translations.idiomatic: Above all the Mourning Garments—the former kings' great design, carried in practice to set the human way right.

sentences.zh: 一辭寧措，千載是遵，涉於異端，豈曰弘教。

translations.literal: One word is better left unchanged; for a thousand years it is followed; to touch heterodox paths—how may one call that broadening teaching?
translations.idiomatic: A single phrase is not lightly altered; a thousand years follow it; to wander into side paths is not to enlarge teaching.

sentences.zh: 伏望各依正禮，以厚儒風。

translations.literal: We prostrate ourselves and hope each will follow the correct rites to thicken Confucian custom.
translations.idiomatic: I beg that all adhere to the orthodox rites and strengthen Confucian practice.

sentences.zh: 太常所謂增加，愚見以為不可。」

translations.literal: What the Court of Imperial Sacrifices calls increases, in my foolish view, cannot be accepted."
translations.idiomatic: What the Court of Imperial Sacrifices calls increases, in my foolish view, cannot be accepted."

sentences.zh: 又戶部郎中楊伯成、左監門錄事參軍劉秩並同是議，與沔等略同。

translations.literal: Also Bureau Director in the Ministry of Revenue Yang Bocheng and Left Gate Recorder Liu Zhi all submitted the same opinion, broadly matching Mian and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The quote ended. Bureau Director Yang Bocheng in the Ministry of Revenue and Left Gate Recorder Liu Zhi also wrote in the same vein, broadly agreeing with Cui Mian and his allies.

sentences.zh: 議奏，上又手敕侍臣等曰：「朕以為親姨舅既服小功，則舅母於舅有三年之服，服是受我而厚，以服制情，則舅母之服，不得全降於舅也，宜服緦麻。堂姨舅古今未制服，朕思惇睦九族，引而親之，宜服袒免。又鄭玄注《禮記》云『同爨緦』，若比堂姨舅於同爨，親則厚矣。又《喪服傳》云『外親之服皆緦』，是亦不隔於堂姨舅也。若以所服不得過本，而須為外曾祖父母及外伯叔祖父母制服，亦何傷乎？是皆親親敦本之意，卿等更熟詳之。」

translations.literal: When the deliberations were submitted, the emperor again personally instructed his attendants, saying: "I consider that since close maternal aunts and uncles already receive small-work mourning, and an uncle's wife has three-year mourning for the uncle, her mourning is thickened by receiving it from me. If mourning dress regulates feeling, then mourning for an uncle's wife cannot be wholly lowered from that for the uncle, and she should receive fine hemp. Second maternal aunts and uncles have never had mourning dress fixed in ancient or recent times, but I think of strengthening harmony among the nine kin, drawing them in and making them close, so they should receive bared-shoulder exemption. Also, Zheng Xuan's annotation to the Book of Rites says, "Those who share the cooking hearth receive fine hemp." If second maternal aunts and uncles are compared to those who share the hearth, this is thick in kinship. Again the Mourning Dress Tradition says, "Mourning for external kin is all fine hemp." This too does not exclude second maternal aunts and uncles. If one says that the mourning worn may not exceed the root, and therefore mourning dress must also be made for external great-grandparents and external great-uncles and great-aunts, what harm would that do? All this is the intention of loving kin and thickening the root. You should examine it further and carefully."
translations.idiomatic: When the deliberations were submitted, the emperor again personally instructed his attendants, saying: "I consider that since close maternal aunts and uncles already receive small-work mourning, and an uncle's wife has three-year mourning for the uncle, her mourning is thickened by receiving it from me. If mourning dress regulates feeling, then mourning for an uncle's wife cannot be wholly lowered from that for the uncle, and she should receive fine hemp. Second maternal aunts and uncles have never had mourning dress fixed in ancient or recent times, but I think of strengthening harmony among the nine kin, drawing them in and making them close, so they should receive bared-shoulder exemption. Also, Zheng Xuan's annotation to the Book of Rites says, "Those who share the cooking hearth receive fine hemp." If second maternal aunts and uncles are compared to those who share the hearth, this is thick in kinship. Again the Mourning Dress Tradition says, "Mourning for external kin is all fine hemp." This too does not exclude second maternal aunts and uncles. If one says that the mourning worn may not exceed the root, and therefore mourning dress must also be made for external great-grandparents and external great-uncles and great-aunts, what harm would that do? All this is the intention of loving kin and thickening the root. You should examine it further and carefully."

sentences.zh: 侍中裴耀卿、中書令張九齡、禮部尚書李林甫等奏曰：「外族之親，禮無厭降。

translations.literal: Attendant-in-chief Pei Yaoqing, Grand Counselor Zhang Jiuling, Minister of Rites Li Linfu, and others memorialized, saying: "Kin of the external clan—in ritual there is no suppressed demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Attendant Pei Yaoqing, Grand Counselor Zhang Jiuling, Minister of Rites Li Linfu, and others wrote: "External kin are not subject to ritual demotion.

sentences.zh: 外甥既為舅母制服，舅母還合報之。

translations.literal: The sister's son already wears mourning for the mother's brother's wife; the mother's brother's wife in turn ought to return it.
translations.idiomatic: A nephew already mourns his aunt by marriage; she in turn should return the obligation.

sentences.zh: 夫外甥既為報服，則與夫之姨舅，以類是同，外甥之妻，不得無服。

translations.literal: Since the sister's son already wears return mourning, then with the husband's mother's brothers and sisters it is the same by category; the sister's son's wife cannot be without mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If a nephew wears return mourning, the same logic covers the husband's aunts and uncles; a nephew's wife cannot go without dress.

sentences.zh: 所增者頗廣，所引者漸疏。

translations.literal: What is added is rather broad; what is cited grows ever more distant.
translations.idiomatic: What is added grows wide; what is cited grows remote.

sentences.zh: 微臣愚蒙，猶有未達。」

translations.literal: We, foolish and ignorant petty officials, still do not fully grasp it."
translations.idiomatic: We, foolish and ignorant petty officials, still do not fully grasp it."

sentences.zh: 玄宗又手製答曰：「從服有六，此其一也。降殺之制，禮無明文。此皆自身率親，用為制服。所有存抑，儘是推恩。朕情有未安，故令詳議，非欲苟求變古，以示不同。卿等以為『外族之親，禮無厭降，報服之制，所引甚疏』。且姨舅者，屬從之至近也，以親言之，則亦姑伯之匹敵也。豈有所引者疏，而降所親者服？又婦，從夫者也。夫之姨舅，夫既有服，從夫而服，由是睦親。實欲令不肖者企及，賢者俯就。卿等宜熟詳之。」耀卿等奏曰：「陛下體至仁之德，廣推恩之道，將弘引進，以示睦親，再發德音，更令詳議。

translations.literal: Xuanzong again composed a personal reply: "There are six kinds of derivative mourning, and this is one of them. As for the rules of lowering and reducing, the ritual has no clear text. These all proceed from oneself in leading kin and are used to make mourning dress. What is preserved and restrained is entirely a pushing outward of grace. My feeling is not settled, and therefore I ordered detailed deliberation; I did not wish merely to seek alteration of antiquity in order to show difference. You and the others consider that 'for kin of the external clan, ritual has no suppressing reduction, and the reciprocal mourning system is drawn from very distant cases.' But maternal aunts and uncles belong to the closest of derivative kin. Speaking by kinship, they also match paternal aunts and uncles. How could the examples cited be distant, while the mourning for close kin is reduced? Also, a wife follows her husband. Since the husband has mourning for his maternal aunts and uncles, she wears mourning by following her husband, and in this way kinship is harmonized. I truly wish to make the unworthy reach upward and the worthy bend downward. You and the others should examine this thoroughly." Yao Chong and the others memorialized: "Your Majesty embodies utmost benevolence and extends the Way of grace broadly, intending to enlarge drawing-in and show harmony among kin; you have again issued virtuous words and again ordered detailed deliberation.

sentences.zh: 臣等按《大唐新禮》：親舅加至小功，與從母同服。

translations.literal: Your servants examine the New Tang Rites: the mother's brother increased to xiao gong, the same mourning as the mother's sister.
translations.idiomatic: We have reviewed the New Tang Rites: a mother's brother was raised to xiao gong, matching the mother's sister.

sentences.zh: 此蓋當時特命，不以輕重遞增，蓋不欲參於本宗，慎於變禮者也。

translations.literal: This was at that time a special command, not increasing grade by grade, broadly not wishing to mix with the root lineage—caution in altering ritual.
translations.idiomatic: That was a special order of the time, not a ladder of ever-heavier grades—chiefly to keep external kin from merging with the main line, a cautious change of ritual.

sentences.zh: 今聖制親姨舅小功，更制舅母緦麻，堂姨舅袒免等服，取類《新禮》，垂示將來，通於物情，自我作則。

translations.literal: Now the sage regulation makes mother's brothers and sisters xiao gong, further regulating the mother's brother's wife as si hemp, hall mother's brothers and sisters as tan mian, and the like—taking categories from the New Rites, displaying them for the future, penetrating common feeling, making the rule oneself.
translations.idiomatic: Now Your Majesty sets mother's brothers and sisters at xiao gong, an aunt by marriage at si hemp, and cousins on the mother's side at tan mian—following the New Rites as a type, showing the future a rule that fits human feeling and is made here and now.

sentences.zh: 群儒風議，徒有稽留。

translations.literal: The multitude of Confucians in discussion merely had delay.
translations.idiomatic: The Confucian debaters had only delayed.

sentences.zh: 並望准制施行。」

translations.literal: We all hope the regulation will be approved and put into practice."
translations.idiomatic: We all hope the regulation will be approved and put into practice."

sentences.zh: 制從之。

translations.literal: The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The quote ended. The regulation was approved.

sentences.zh: 天寶六載正月，出嫁母宜終服三年。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianbao, in the first month, a mother who has married out her son should complete the three-year mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tianbao, first month: a married-out mother should observe the full three-year mourning.
